name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo's career started in law enforcement in São Paulo, where he spent over a decade honing his skills in risk assessment and security protocols. A lifelong motorsports enthusiast, he transitioned into the racing world after identifying critical vulnerabilities in trackside security during a local event. His meticulous approach to security planning and crisis management quickly earned him a reputation, leading him to his current role as Security Chief for Crown Racing. 

Ricardo believes in a proactive, adaptable security strategy, constantly evaluating potential threats and tailoring his approach to the specific challenges of each race. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to implement effective security measures without disrupting the team's focus. His experience and his commitment to safety makes him an invaluable asset to Crown Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stout man with a commanding presence and a watchful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie, even when he's not wearing one.
Refuses to eat anything green before a race, believing it brings bad luck.
